scripts.build: npm run build:client && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/worker
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json && wrangler types --check
scripts.test: npm run build:client && vitest run && npm run test:privacy-scan
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test
